text:
anna: Quick thread: QuantumEdge partner reports billing mismatches for their marketplace SKU after we onboarded their new aggregator. Looks like a windowing + SKU mapping issue.

mike: Seen similar: aggregator emits minute buckets in local tz and labels SKU as 'qe-basic' while marketplace expects 'quantumedge-basic-hour'. Mapping layer currently does a naive string replace and loses multiplier.

kevin: Minimal fixes: (1) normalise incoming minute_start -> UTC ISO; (2) adapter must accept "sku_alias" list and map to canonical SKU + multiplier; (3) express qty as fractional hours (1min=0.01666667) and round to 8 decimals.

anna: Need reconciliation plan: daily diff job at 02:00 UTC comparing partner minute-aggregates -> invoiceable hours. If delta > 1% open billing review, <=1% auto-adjust. Backfill path: partner can provide minute archives for last 7 days; we'll run dry-run then adjustments.

mike: Example ingest payload (compact):
```json
{"device":"qe-12","minute_start":"2026-03-20T23:59:00+01:00","sku_alias":"qe-basic","count":1}
```
Adapter should normalise minute_start-> 2026-03-20T22:59:00Z and emit usage_key sha256(partner+device+minute_epoch).

kevin: Action items: anna write partner note + schedule sync (ETA 24h). mike implement adapter alias map + tz normalization (ETA 48h). kevin prepare reconcile job + dashboard panel (ETA 72h). ops-bot: create incident INC-2026-1501 if daily delta > 2%

anna: I'll host partner call tomorrow 11am PT; bring samples.
